name: standard-card-frame-v1
description: Locked content regions for card frames. Design styling may change freely; these region positions and sizes must stay fixed.

title_box.description: Top-centered horizontal box for card title/name. Design of the box may change; position and size are locked.

art_window.description: Large central transparent rectangle for primary artwork. Must remain a clear, unobstructed opening at this location.

bottom_left_box.description: Bottom-left horizontal box for stats, abilities, or secondary text. Design may change; position and size are locked.

bottom_right_box.description: Bottom-right horizontal box for stats, abilities, or secondary text. Design may change; position and size are locked.

notes: The three areas to preserve are: (1) title_box, (2) art_window, (3) the bottom footer pair (bottom_left_box + bottom_right_box).
Bottom left and right are separate slots but together form the single bottom footer area from the reference frame.
Decorative frame, borders, crests, and ornaments may be redesigned freely as long as they do not move or cover these regions.
A center bottom crest/peak may sit between the two bottom boxes (roughly x 335–415) without overlapping the locked boxes.
